quarterly_data.signal: 10-K backlog: remaining performance obligations were $23.76 billion and backlog $43.98 billion as of December 31, 2025, increases of 41.8% and 27.3% relative to December 31, 2024, with 66.1% of remaining performance obligations expected to be recognized in the subsequent twelve months. Electric segment backlog was $36,166,706 thousand in total ($21,944,092 thousand expected within 12 months) versus $28,627,807 thousand at December 31, 2024. Quanta attributes the increases partly to 2025 acquisitions and partly to new project awards with existing customers.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $23.76 billion (+41.8%) and backlog $43.98 billion (+27.3%) as of December 31, 2025 vs December 31, 2024; Electric backlog $36,166,706 thousand ($21,944,092 thousand within 12 months) vs $28,627,807 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K manufacturing capacity and capex: Quanta owns manufacturing facilities in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania; Raeford, North Carolina; and Erie County, New York, associated with its businesses that specialize in manufacturing power transformers and related electrical components. As of December 31, 2025 it had commitments, primarily for capital expansion of certain manufacturing facilities and expansion of its equipment fleet, of $265.1 million in 2026 and $83.9 million thereafter. It expects capital expenditures for property and equipment of approximately $750 million to $800 million for 2026, after $609.2 million of capital expenditures in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 capex expected ~$750 million to $800 million (2025: $609.2 million); manufacturing-facility and fleet expansion commitments $265.1 million in 2026 and $83.9 million thereafter
